name: add_task
description: Capture a to-do or work action, including emailing a person. Keep due_date as the user's relative phrase; do not calculate dates.

due_date.description: Verbatim relative due date phrase, or empty string if absent

assignee.description: Who must do the task, or empty string if unspecified. Email recipients are not assignees.

name: add_note
description: Capture observations, meeting outcomes, decisions, or information to remember.

body.description: The observation with names and details preserved

topic.description: Short topic such as work, or empty string

name: add_reminder
description: Capture an explicit request to remind the user to do something at a time. Preserve the relative time phrase.

title.description: What to remind the user about

remind_at.description: Verbatim time phrase, e.g. tomorrow at 3pm; empty if absent. Do not calculate a date.

name: add_shopping_item
description: Add one item to a shopping list. Buying or grabbing groceries is shopping. Emit one call per distinct item, preserving the store for each.

quantity.description: Quantity with units as spoken, or empty string if unspecified

store.description: Store name, or empty string if unspecified

name: log_idea
description: Capture a speculative suggestion, creative idea, or what-if question.
